notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
The following games are 100% compatible with Steam deck and do not require any modifications.
 
- Brutal Dinosaur
- Heroes of Sacred Tree 
- Arauco Saga 
- RTO Deluxe Edition

All the games are available in a single bundle.

notes.title: Brutal Dinosaur Version 1.5
notes.content:
Update brutal dinosaur 1.5


- Fixed the hurtbox of all players and enemies.

- All hitboxed are fixed now the combos are exact from enemies and players.

- Fixed animations by extracting phrases and speeding up animations to make them more fluid.

- Attached the reappearance of the players when losing they make a special move to get rid of the enemies that are nearby.

- A text balloon was added like the comics that appear in the moments where the mode gun and the beat em up mode are used, so that the player understands the mechanics better.

- Now also the player when being hit by the enemies can fall and recover and fight again this prevents him from being hit without stopping and the player is killed, the most powerful enemies give a single blow and knock down the player for example the triceratops enemy boss.

- The enemies have different behaviors and strategies to attack the players, they are more intelligent and aggressive and their AI can be easily configured.

- Some sprites have been changed and the speed of the menu has been improved.

- Added more damage to the raw character so that he is the strongest character and that does more damage so that he differs from the other playable characters.


- It was enabled to play with the keyboard and control the interface:

CONTROLS: 

A W D S: MOVE

ATTACK: H

ATTACK 2: N

JUMP: J

SPECIAL: SPACE

SUPERPOWER: L 

JUGGLE: B

MODE GUN : K

GRANADE : G

DASH : V

notes.title: Brutal Dinosaur 1.0
notes.content:
Brutal Dinosaur
UPDATE 1.0



1-	Incorporation of character 3 called Vicky, she is the daughter of the scientist Suna and seeks to avenge her father, this character is accompanied by Anima her dog.
2-	Fixed the defects in the collisions that made the game unplayable in certain parts. 
3-	Corrected the collider of the enemies the aggressiveness of them.
4-	Added in gun mode now characters can walk while in gun mode.
5-	Fixed speed for dodging bullets.
6-	Added the menu to choose character in the game.
7-	Added to enter to play with player two while playing in single mode.
8-	Added in the gun mode shoot with the button pressed.
9-	Change Karen’s main hit for new sprites and collisions.
10-	Added a new kick button to the character Karen.
11-	The second air combo was eliminated because it gave many problems with the enemies.
12-	More speed in Karen Bruto’s areal combos 
13-	Fixed the problem of the options menu in the main menu.
14-	Added the possibility of playing with 2 identical characters.
15-	Changed the comics to add the new character.
